PF1EL.Help.ClassFeatures: Grant these items as children when this item's associated class reaches the listed level.
PF1EL.Help.SpellSupplements: Route these spells into a spellbook. Choose the destination and, optionally, gate each spell behind a class level or Hit Dice total.
PF1EL.PerDayHint: Uses per day for this spell-like ability. 0 = at will.
PF1EL.PoolHint: Spells in one pool share a single daily count.
PF1EL.Grant.Title: Granted by
PF1EL.Mode.Label: Destination
PF1EL.Gating.Label: Level gating
PF1EL.Castable.Label: Require castable level
PF1EL.Castable.Hint: Also hold each spell back until the destination spellbook can cast that spell level. A partial caster then receives a spell later than a full caster does — or never, if its progression never reaches that level.
PF1EL.Domain.Label: Domain/School spells
PF1EL.Domain.Hint: Mark granted spells as Domain/School spells.
PF1EL.BonusKnown.Label: Bonus spells known
PF1EL.BonusKnown.Hint: For a class that knows a set number of spells: these don't count against it.
PF1EL.Archetype.DropClass: Drop the base class here to choose which features it replaces.
PF1EL.Warning.ClassOnly: Drop a class item here to pick the base class.

PF1EL.Warning.BadDrop: That item could not be resolved and was not added.
PF1EL.Warning.SourceMissing: That link's source item could not be found.
PF1EL.Setting.Dedupe.Name: Don't duplicate linked items
PF1EL.Setting.Dedupe.Hint: When Supplements or Class Features would add something the actor already has, use the existing item instead of creating a copy. Physical items and spells are always copied.
PF1EL.Rename.Add: Rename the item this link adds
PF1EL.Rename.Title: Rename on add
PF1EL.Rename.Label: New name
PF1EL.Rename.Hint: Leave empty to keep the original name.
PF1EL.Warning.NoClassSpell: This item type can't be tied to a class, so Class Spellcasting is unavailable — spells will route to Spell-like Abilities.
PF1EL.Cast.Title: Spellcasting
PF1EL.Cast.Hint: Add this feature's class levels to another spellbook.
PF1EL.Cast.Mode.Label: Own spellbook
PF1EL.Cast.ModifyHint: Changes the associated class's spellbook while the item is on the actor.
PF1EL.Cast.Mod.NotApplied: No spellbook for this class on this actor.
PF1EL.Cast.Mod.OffsetsHint: Added to every spell level. Blank or 0 adds nothing.
PF1EL.Cast.Warn.Clash: {item} changes a spellbook setting that another item also changes. The later one wins.
PF1EL.Cast.Warn.NoPsionics: {item} grants a psionic manifester, but pf1-psionics is not active.
PF1EL.Cast.ClassNotice: Set spellcasting on a class feature instead (Spellcasting section, Grant a spellbook).
PF1EL.Cast.Warn.ClassCasts: {item} grants a spellbook, but the {class} class still has its own spellcasting set. This can make two spellbooks for one class.
PF1EL.Cast.GrantHint: The actor has this spellbook while the item is on it.
PF1EL.Cast.Book.Name: Book name
PF1EL.Cast.Book.ListHint: Class tag whose spell list the book uses, such as wizard. Blank uses its own class.
PF1EL.Cast.Book.NotGranted: No spellbook on this actor yet.
PF1EL.Cast.Slots.Title: Spell rules
PF1EL.Cast.Slots.Hint: Special slots, spells that cost extra, spells cast by giving up another, and metamagic.
PF1EL.Cast.Slots.Label: Rules
PF1EL.Cast.NoClassNote: No associated class on this actor, so nothing is advanced.
PF1EL.Cast.Dialog.Title: {item}: Choose Spellcasting
PF1EL.Cast.Warn.NoClass: {item} has no associated class on this actor, so it has nothing to advance with.
PF1EL.Cast.Warn.NoBooks: {item}: no eligible spellbook is in use yet.
PF1EL.Cast.Warn.OwnClass: {item} belongs to {class}, so it can't advance that class's own spellbook. Associate it with the class whose levels it should add.

PF1EL.Cast.Warn.SameBook: Each choice must be a different spellbook.

PF1EL.Cast.Warn.PsionicField: {book}: the added class levels had no effect. This version of PF1 Psionics has no Class Level Modification field.
PF1EL.Cast.Warn.Manual: {book}: Class Level Modification already counts this class, so it was left unchanged.
PF1EL.Sel.Title: Selections
PF1EL.Sel.Role.Label: Role
PF1EL.Sel.GrantHint: The owner picks from every item carrying one of the tags.
PF1EL.Sel.Heading: Heading
PF1EL.Sel.ClassHint: Class tag whose level counts, such as barbarian. Blank uses the associated class.
PF1EL.Sel.GrantAs.Label: Grant spells as

PF1EL.Sel.AddSpellList: Add a spell list, such as wizard

PF1EL.Sel.DropListed: Drop items or folders to list them
PF1EL.Sel.KeepHint: Leave this feature where it is once its picks are made.
PF1EL.Sel.OptionHint: Rules for picking this item. All are optional.
PF1EL.Sel.GroupHint: Items in one group must share a branch.

PF1EL.Sel.Repeatable: Can be picked more than once
PF1EL.Sel.Warn.ListedOnly: Only items and item folders can be listed.
PF1EL.Sel.Warn.RequiresOnly: Only an item can be required.

PF1EL.Sel.Picker.Title: {item}: Choose
PF1EL.Sel.Picker.SortDefaultHint: Available first, then by level, then by name.
PF1EL.Sel.Picker.SortAlphaHint: By name only. Click again to reverse.
PF1EL.Sel.Picker.Empty: Nothing to pick from. Check the selection's tags.
PF1EL.Setting.HideFilled.Name: Hide Hidden Features from players
PF1EL.Setting.HideFilled.Hint: Leaves the Hidden Features category off players' sheets. A GM always sees it.
PF1EL.Sel.Warn.PickFailed: The pick could not be saved. See the console (F12).
PF1EL.Uninstall.Menu.Name: Prepare for Uninstall
PF1EL.Uninstall.Menu.Label: Open
PF1EL.Uninstall.Menu.Hint: Clean up what this module added before you turn it off.
PF1EL.Uninstall.Title: Prepare for Uninstall
PF1EL.Uninstall.Intro: With the module off, a feature it moved to Hidden Features is listed nowhere on the sheet. Choose one of these first.
PF1EL.Uninstall.Paused: The module is paused. It grants and moves nothing until the preparation is undone.
PF1EL.Uninstall.Found: Found: {picks} picks on {actors} actors, {moved} features in Hidden Features, {parked} parked in Misc.
PF1EL.Uninstall.Undo.Label: Undo every pick
PF1EL.Uninstall.Undo.Hint: Deletes each picked item and puts its feature back. Cannot be undone.
PF1EL.Uninstall.Park.Label: Move hidden features to Misc
PF1EL.Uninstall.Park.Hint: Keeps every pick. Features this module moved become visible under Misc.
PF1EL.Uninstall.Restore.Label: Undo preparation
PF1EL.Uninstall.Restore.Hint: Moves parked features back and resumes the module. Undone picks stay undone.
PF1EL.Uninstall.Scope: Covers world actors and unlinked tokens. Actors in compendiums are not touched.
PF1EL.Uninstall.Confirm.Undo: Delete {picks} picks on {actors} actors, put their features back, and pause the module?
PF1EL.Uninstall.Confirm.Final: This cannot be undone. Each picked item is deleted, along with any changes made to it. Continue?
PF1EL.Uninstall.Confirm.Park: Move {moved} features from Hidden Features to Misc and pause the module?
PF1EL.Uninstall.Confirm.Restore: Move {parked} parked features back and resume the module?
PF1EL.Uninstall.Done.Undo: Picks undone. The module is paused and can be turned off.
PF1EL.Uninstall.Done.Park: Hidden features moved to Misc. The module is paused and can be turned off.
PF1EL.Uninstall.Done.Restore: Preparation undone. The module is running again.
PF1EL.Uninstall.Failed: Some actors could not be updated. See the console (F12).
PF1EL.Uninstall.Notice: PF1 Enhanced Links is paused for uninstall. Undo the preparation in its settings to resume.
PF1EL.Sources.Menu.Name: Selection Sources
PF1EL.Sources.Menu.Label: Configure

PF1EL.Sources.Title: Selection Sources
